title: Killing of Caltech astronomer Carl Grillmair

tellings.quote: On February 16th, 2026, about 30 mi northeast of Waterman Mountain, where Monica Resza disappeared, another colleague from Caltech and JPL would meet an equally tragic and suspicious end.

plain: On February 16, 2026, in Llano in California's Antelope Valley, the astronomer Carl Grillmair, who worked at Caltech (a university in Pasadena) and JPL (NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory), met what Michels calls a tragic and suspicious end. Michels points out that this was about 30 miles northeast of Waterman Mountain, where another colleague, Monica Resza, had disappeared. He tells it himself, drawing on someone named Freddy Snyder, in an episode about top American scientists going missing, as though the two cases might be part of a pattern.
